chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl al-Mīthamī narrated to us. He said: Ribʿī ibn ʿAbdillāh narrated to us. He said: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh said to me:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “Is the one who denies this matter, from Banī Hāshim and from others, the same?” So he said to me: “Do not say ‘the denier’; rather say ‘the rejecter,’ from Banī Hāshim and from others.”
Abū al-Ḥasan said: “So I reflected upon it, and I remembered the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, regarding the brothers of Yūsuf:”
“So he recognized them, while they were to him unrecognizing.”

key_terms.الْجَاحِدُ: one who knowingly rejects or repudiates the truth
key_terms.الْمُنْكِرُ: one who does not recognize or acknowledge something
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: this matter, referring in context to the divinely appointed authority

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between someone who does not recognize the truth and someone who knowingly rejects it in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith distinguishes between merely not recognizing something and knowingly rejecting it, especially concerning this matter of authority. The Imam عليه السلام corrects the wording to indicate deliberate rejection, and the narrator supports this distinction through the Qur'anic usage in the story of Yūsuf عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Rashid who said, ‘Ali Bin Ismail Al Maysami narrated to us saying, ‘Rabie Bin Abdullah narrated to us saying,

‘Abdul Rahman son of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to him, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The denier of the matter (Al-Wilayah), from the Clan of Hashim<sup>as</sup> and others are equal?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘No. Do not say, ‘the denier’, but say, ‘the rejecter (disbeliever)’, from the Clan of Hashim<sup>as</sup> and others’’.
Abu Al-Hassan (the narrator) said, ‘So I pondered in it and I remembered the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic regarding the brothers of Yusuf<sup>as</sup>.
[12:58] and he knew them, while they did not recognise him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Rashid who has that reported to us Ali ibn ’Isma‘il al-Maythami who has said that narrated to us Rabi’i ibn ‘Abdallah who has said that said to him ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abdallah the following.

“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘are those who are ignorant of this matter (Leadership with Divine Authority) of the descendants of Hashim and others the same?” He said to me, “Do not say, “al-Munkir” (ignorant) but say al-Jahid (rejecter ) of the descendants of Hashim and other people.”
Abu al-Hassan has said I thought about it and then I recalled the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, about the brothers of Yusuf (Joseph)
“He recognized them but they were ignorant about him.” [12:58]
